aiModels.name: Academic Momentum & Disengagement Early Indicator Engine
aiModels.intendedUse: Decision support for academic advisors and faculty to detect emerging attendance and assessment disengagement before critical grading deadlines.
aiModels.prohibitedUse: Automated administrative sanctions, financial aid revocation, disciplinary decisions, or clinical diagnosis inference.
aiModels.knownLimitations: Requires at least 2 weeks of enrolled course data for calibrated inference; falls back to deterministic rule engine when missing LMS logs.

aiModels.name: Deterministic Transparent Pedagogical Rule System
aiModels.trainedOnCohort: Rule-based benchmark validated against AAC&U Student Success Standards
aiModels.intendedUse: Transparent baseline rules engine for early semester onboarding (<14 days of instruction).
aiModels.prohibitedUse: Consequential automated grading or credit determinations.
aiModels.knownLimitations: Rule thresholds are static and do not adapt dynamically to course syllabus complexity variations.

aiModels.name: Legacy Linear Benchmark Estimator
aiModels.intendedUse: Historical comparative benchmark; not recommended for active primary advising triage.
aiModels.prohibitedUse: Active student intervention routing without newer ensemble cross-validation.
aiModels.knownLimitations: Linear decision boundary fails to capture multi-course non-linear attendance dropoffs.
